correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact four-node Lagrange interpolation coefficients, two-step companion determinant and trace, and strict scaled quadratic Schur--Jury certificates with manifestly positive polynomial numerators. The r->0 and infinity limits give the sharp 1/5 supremum. The reciprocal discriminant and one-sign-change quartic prove the phase boundary, and simple unit multiplier plus strictly damped parasitic multipliers yield fixed-r zero stability. All critical rational identities were replayed from a standalone checker.
